project.name: DGF
project.title: DGF-N4 falsification and DGF-N5 cross-representation invariant pivot

core_claim: DGF-N4 is not established as a physical mass-boundary mechanism; it is downgraded to a constrained statistical ansatz, and the active north star becomes DGF-N5: a cross-representation invariant / identifiability principle.
not_claimed: Macroscopic residual-world ontology has been strictly proven
Massive objects are proven to have lost spatial information after the Big Bang
13.85 microgram is a proven natural coherence mass ceiling
q_visibility equals q_DGF_mass without an independent bridge observable
LLR advantage of a pointwise q_i model is evidence for a DGF physical mechanism

fatal_reasons: incomplete penalized likelihood / null / bootstrap table
low-rank graph model flexibility not closed by preregistration

active_next_priority.question: Does a DGF endpoint structure survive after pointwise freedoms are frozen, model complexity is preregistered, and at least two independent representations support the same invariant?
active_next_priority.tie_break: DGF-N5, DGF-N6, and DGF-N8 scored 3.75; DGF-N5 is selected by re-escalation origin and depth priority.

subclaims.question: Can q_DGF_mass be calibrated without using visibility data?
Does a preregistered low-rank / graph q model still beat environment nulls after effective degrees of freedom are penalized?
Does the fold-type critical endpoint survive across visibility, mass proxy, environment channel, or information-geometric coordinates?
